info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Transaction Review Submission API
info.description: The Card Transaction Review Submission API enables financial institutions to submit reviews of card transactions for operational oversight and compliance. It facilitates the collection of critical feedback on transactions, which can be leveraged to enhance customer service and mitigate fraud risks. This API is designed for banking and finance professionals who manage transaction reviews, ensuring they can efficiently log and analyze feedback on transactions. Typical consumers include compliance officers and transaction monitoring teams seeking to improve operational efficacy.

post.summary: Create a review for a card transaction.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific card transaction, identified by its unique CARD ID. The review data submitted will be processed and associated with the transaction, contributing to the overall feedback concerning the card services.
